Return safe metadata about which CorbitChat plugin features (reports, schedule approval, chat, Assistant) are available to the connected Jira user, plus supported date formats and terminology. Read-only; no secrets. Use this to discover plugin features.

Read the deterministic report window ledger for an issue (FUTURE/OPEN/SATISFIED/MISSED/LATE/…). Empty for fixed-minimum mode. Plugin report data, not Jira worklogs.

Returns currentWindowState (covered|missing|invalid_only|not_due|closed|not_applicable|configuration_incomplete), actionRequiredNow, current window bounds, and historicalContext kept SEPARATE. Historical misses never make a currently-covered issue 'missing'. Use for 'الان/بازه جاری/امروز/نیاز به پیگیری'. For full history use corbit_reports_get_issue.

List which issues currently HAVE vs LACK a valid report in the active window (covered/missing/invalid_only/not_due/closed/...). scope=my_current_window (default: your assigned issues) or team_current_window/project_current_window (Jira admin only; non-admins get manager_scope_not_permitted). Use for 'الان کدام تسک‌ها گزارش ندارند؟'. Historical misses are context only, never current state.

Dry-run check whether a CorbitChat report can be submitted on an issue (configured, applicable, window open, permission) using the plugin's canonical state. No side effects — creates nothing. Use before 'گزارش ثبت کن' to see if it will be valid.

If configured=false or approverConfigured=false, then canSubmit=false — tell the user it is not set up; do NOT propose a date. This is the plugin completion-date workflow — NOT Jira worklog/time-tracking/due date.
